brief: Daan, eighteen-year-old male frontier archer. Short violet hair swept sideways, clean-shaven youthful face, practical plum scarf over brown leather and muted blue tunic. One bowstring and quiver edge visible behind shoulder, friendly shrewd expression. No heavy armor.
hair_style: straight violet side-part, neatly clipped at the temples, a single smooth diagonal fringe; NO spikes, no fluffy crown
face_notes: a narrow long face, thin brows and a sly modest smile

brief: Otto, forty-four-year-old former infantry soldier. Weathered face with visible age lines, auburn hair tied back, light auburn-and-grey stubble, sturdy neck, repaired iron shoulder plate and faded maroon winter scarf. Dependable, remorseful, visibly middle aged; never a teenage face.
hair_style: auburn-and-grey hair swept fully BACK from a visibly high forehead into a LOW long ponytail; no fringe, no spiky hair
face_notes: broad middle-aged face with coarse age lines, grey-auburn beard stubble and heavier brows

brief: Fula, twenty-four-year-old woman, relief worker and nun. Lavender bob-cut hair, purple and cream modest clerical layers, simple scarf and small wooden faith pendant, compassionate but firm expression, adult face, practical healer outfit rather than elaborate princess jewelry.

Lena, twenty-two-year-old female cavalry knight. Short blue hair, alert adult face, red riding scarf, dark steel shoulder armor, a small broken old-order insignia retained as a plain clasp. Resolute and dignified; no wings or crowns.

Lance, twenty-one-year-old male cavalry knight. Olive-green side-parted hair, youthful clean-shaven face, blue and brass cavalry collar over practical armor, small orange scarf. Thoughtful and loyal, slightly guarded expression.
hair_style: olive-green hair slicked back with a clean side part and tucked behind both ears into a small low knot; completely open forehead
face_notes: long oval youthful adult face, straight nose, refined restrained eyes and no beard

brief: Beck, seventeen-year-old male apprentice miner. Bright blue hair, boyish clean-shaven face with a faint dust smudge, simple cobalt work tunic and brown miner apron strap, leather tool loop at shoulder. Curious hopeful expression; no noble armor, no adult beard.
hair_style: dark steel-BLUE very short rounded crop, a flat soft blunt fringe, close-cut sides, NO spikes or long locks
face_notes: rounder boyish face, brown-grey eyes and a warm slightly uneven smile; distinct from Hunapu

brief: Hervi, nineteen-year-old male clinic apprentice and mage. Short spiky auburn-red hair, clean-shaven young face, dark green scarf and cream clinic robe with a restrained stitched spell-learning trim. Studious skeptical expression; no veteran wrinkles or huge helmet.
hair_style: auburn-red SHORT TIGHT CURLS with clipped sides and an off-centre curl, NO long spiky fringe
face_notes: fine narrow young face, skeptical brows and a small questioning mouth

brief: German, thirty-eight-year-old male coastal mercenary commander. Tousled violet-brown hair, short rough beard, weathered adult face, chipped bronze and muted ochre shoulder armor with a blue neck cloth. Tired, pragmatic, determined to protect his men.
hair_style: muted violet-BROWN very short receding brush cut with visible mature temples; no thick fringe
face_notes: weathered broad38-year-old face, a short coarse beard and a pragmatic unsmiling expression

brief: Mireille, seventeen-year-old female island nun and healer. Soft pink bob-cut hair, gentle youthful face, violet-blue high-collared relief robe with a cream hood folded down, modest shoulders, small plain wooden pendant. Anxious but courageous, compassionate, no adult glamour or ornate crown.

Lisa, sixteen-year-old female student mage. Pink hair in a high practical ponytail, lively youthful face, pale lilac and violet modest high-collared robe with simple teal lining, a small apprentice brooch. Impatient bright expression, age-appropriate and fully clothed, no mature glamour.

Carlo, thirty-four-year-old male seafaring mercenary and old bodyguard. Short sandy auburn hair, light rough stubble, angular weathered adult face, dark blue scarf, ochre leather shoulder guard over worn indigo clothes. A guarded, regretful but dependable expression. No teenager appearance.
hair_style: sandy-auburn WAVY JAW-LENGTH hair, centre part, waves tucked behind one ear; no spikes
face_notes: angular34-year-old face with light rough stubble and tired steady eyes; no eyepatch

brief: Lord, twenty-seven-year-old male shipwright forced into heavy infantry service. Olive-green tousled hair, strong adult face and short stubble, worn russet work scarf and practical heavy steel shoulder armor with leather repair stitching. Broad dependable build, thoughtful expression, no noble coronet.
hair_style: olive-green SHORT FLAT-TOP with a squared hairline and very short sides; no hanging fringe
face_notes: broad square27-year-old jaw and sturdy neck with short stubble, dependable gaze

brief: Roan, twenty-year-old male island fisherman and archer. Short reddish brown hair, sun-tanned youthful clean-shaven face, violet-blue fisherman tunic, weathered tan strap and a quiver rim behind shoulder. Open and practical expression, sea-worn clothes, not a richly armored noble.
hair_style: copper-brown SHOULDER-LENGTH loose waves tied half-up by a plain linen cord, open forehead
face_notes: sun-tanned20-year-old clean-shaven face with a broader nose and open friendly eyes

brief: Shia, nineteen-year-old female flying knight defending an island. Light icy-blue short hair, youthful clear face, pale blue and steel shoulder armor with a small white feather clasp and muted peach riding scarf. Calm responsible expression, no queen crown and no magical wings growing from her body.

Eileen, sixteen-year-old girl and navigation apprentice. Long deep red hair with a loose practical braid, amber eyes, youthful clean face, modest magenta and indigo traveler robe with high collar and a thin ivory sea-cloak. Small brass compass clasp, gentle but determined expression. Age-appropriate, no crown, no sexualized outfit.

Eileen, the SAME sixteen-year-old red-haired girl as her original reference, identical youthful face and amber eyes. Present-time arrival at a guarded celebration after the island voyage: slightly wind-tangled red hair, travel-worn ivory and indigo cloak over modest magenta high-collared robe, wary proud expression. No adult aging, no wounds or gore, no royal regalia.

Eileen, the SAME sixteen-year-old red-haired navigation apprentice, identical face and amber eyes. After recovering her mothers sea chart in chapter two: red hair tied for the voyage, simple ivory sea cloak over a dark indigo and magenta high-collared robe, chart-case strap and tiny brass compass clasp, more focused confident expression. No age increase or crown.
